transcript: I believe that an institutional utopia would be the best scenario here, as the rule of law helps bring order to society. In a religious utopia, faith-based order is wide-encompassing and helps bring a sense of purpose to people. A green utopia would rank third due to its sustainability, followed by a moral commonwealth because intermorality is necessary for the survival of a society. A primitivist utopia would be unideal, but preferable to a futurist or AI-centered utopia, which I view as directly unsustainable in the long run.
